about: The stages of the Nuclear Builder (extensions/tools/nuclear-builder/src/engine.ts).

rows.title: Station 1 of the software factory: Analysis
rows.summary: The spec read by the Analyst: what the client needs, the acceptance criteria, the questions to answer before anything is built (analysis.md).
body: The spec read by the Analyst: what the client needs, the acceptance criteria, the questions to answer before anything is built (analysis.md).
The role that works it: analyst. The station after it: `design`.

rows.title: Station 4 of the software factory: Code
rows.summary: The Developer writes what the generators did not, with the Nuclear MCP server; then the project's check (nuclear check).
body: The Developer writes what the generators did not, with the Nuclear MCP server; then the project's check (nuclear check).
The role that works it: developer. The station after it: `quality`.

rows.title: Station 6 of the software factory: Delivery
rows.summary: DevOps writes the definition of done, the user stories and the pull request's text (and the deployment, when the change touches it); once you approve, the branch, the commit in your name and the pull request with gh (never merged).
body: DevOps writes the definition of done, the user stories and the pull request's text (and the deployment, when the change touches it); once you approve, the branch, the commit in your name and the pull request with gh (never merged).
The role that works it: devops. It is the last station.

rows.title: Station 2 of the software factory: Design
rows.summary: The generators write first what follows from the data (nuclear gen resource); then the Architect designs what is left, with Mermaid diagrams and the ADRs it follows, and splits it into a plan (design.md, plan.md).
body: The generators write first what follows from the data (nuclear gen resource); then the Architect designs what is left, with Mermaid diagrams and the ADRs it follows, and splits it into a plan (design.md, plan.md).
The role that works it: architect. The station after it: `tests`.

rows.title: Station 5 of the software factory: Quality
rows.summary: QA writes its plan into the run's checks and stops for you: switch checks, add your own, run yours; then the project is built and tested and QA runs the rest (qa-report.md).
body: QA writes its plan into the run's checks and stops for you: switch checks, add your own, run yours; then the project is built and tested and QA runs the rest (qa-report.md).
The role that works it: qa. The station after it: `delivery`.

rows.title: Station 3 of the software factory: Tests first
rows.summary: Before any code, the tests from the acceptance criteria and the plan (test-plan.md and the tests in the project).
body: Before any code, the tests from the acceptance criteria and the plan (test-plan.md and the tests in the project).
The role that works it: developer. The station after it: `code`.
